shared_rules.city_title: City identifier in same upper-left header slot above title; no old section/row numbers.
shared_rules.map: True saved WKT geometry; top-down local equirectangular projection; faint road context; continuous numeric colorbar; identical extent and normalization across styles.
shared_rules.curve: 16 recorded Phase-II objective values, rounds 0–15; no smoothing, unit vehicle-minutes; same-graph arc-flow LP reference; strict and degenerate commits distinguishable.
shared_rules.integrity: Only stored table reads and plotting; no optimizer invocation, synthetic geometry or pasted raster panels.
shared_rules.caption: Captions and caveats kept outside figure canvas for webpage.

samples.core_conclusion: The saved Boston ABS_PLANNED Frank–Wolfe flow occupies a subset of the 5091 physical directed links.

evidence.units: modeled vehicle trips in the frozen 26-OD panel

samples.risk: Model results, not observed counts; no citywide calibration claim.

samples.core_conclusion: The recorded Boston bounded-pilot Phase-II objective declines from 64.8296764834 to 64.3968615115 by round 15, including degenerate nonincreasing commits.
samples.risk: Same bounded 90-node/125-link/10-demand finite graph, separate from ABS_PLANNED static instance; reference match alone is not pricing closure.

samples.core_conclusion: The saved rank-26 and rank-52 L3 flows nearly agree with FW; the signed deviations are on the order of 1e-6 modeled vehicle trips, and absolute versus difference views must not be confused.
samples.risk: Actual saved L3 v_from_paths columns, not finite-path reference mislabeled as L3; shared flow/difference scales, no cross-instance comparison.
